ipu_model_wrapper: convert a PyTorch model to an IPU model with training and inference support using poptorch options
get_training_model: create a PopTorch training model from a PyTorch model for IPU hardware execution in training mode
get_inference_model: create a PopTorch inference model from a PyTorch model for IPU hardware execution in inference mode
TrainEvalModel_train_step: run a single training step on the IPU model with data and optimizer for loss computation
WrappedNet_forward: run the wrapped model forward pass converting tuple inputs to dictionary kwargs and back to tuple outputs
